name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement single-qubit randomized benchm
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement single-qubit randomized benchmarking from scratch in Qiskit: generate random Clifford sequences of lengths [1, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80] with recovery, run under depolarizing noise p=0.0098, fit the exponential decay, and report the error per Clifford. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
